notes.title: Apology for the Mistake in Pricing Revision on August 14th
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]First, I want to sincerely apologize to all the supporters who purchased our product during its launch. Earlier today, due to a mistake in price setting, the product price became 7.26 during the final 10 hours of the launch discount. To those who bought it earlier for 9.9, we’re truly sorry for the trouble and inconvenience this has caused you—we really are, from the bottom of our hearts.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Here’s what happened: The launch discount was about to expire today, after which the price would have reverted to our initial original price of 15 yuan. After reviewing everyone’s feedback over this period, we felt 15 yuan might be a bit pricey. So we thought adjusting the price to 11 yuan [i]after[/i] the launch discount ended would be more reasonable—it wouldn’t hurt those who bought during the launch, and it would let more people enjoy the product at a lower price.[/p][p]
[/p][p]But because I’m not familiar with Steam’s backend pricing mechanism, after I adjusted the price to 11 yuan, it took effect immediately... This resulted in the price dropping to 7.26 during the remaining launch discount period, which completely goes against our original intention. However, Steam allows price reductions but doesn’t support increasing prices during discount periods, so I can’t adjust it back now.[/p][p]
[/p][p]So, as things stand, this 7.26 yuan price will remain for the final 10 hours of the launch discount. We can only sincerely apologize—it’s truly due to inexperience and not understanding Steam’s price adjustment logic, not because we intended to “stab in the back” our launch supporters. We really feel sorry for all of you who supported us at launch.[/p][p]
[/p][p]We are truly, truly sorry![/p]
